rationale: Base origin/main. AD-313 update of 2026-11-10 lists the excluded test files in the result note, so the new key never hides a file silently. Measured with validate --against origin/main: calls_unresolved rises from 970 to 977 (net +7). The new calls are path methods in check.observe._observe (relative_to, as_posix, intersection on a receiver typed by the standard library), the sorted and startswith calls of the Observer, and two str lower calls in the scope-change note in check.ports.ScanConfig; the PurePosixPath as_posix call in cli.config only moves lines. No other budget changes. Widening: component ir gains public profiles:TEST_SCOPE_LANGUAGES, the one owner of the languages that honour the test scope; check.ports, check.observe and check.report read it. The digests bind the contract tree and the baseline of origin/main to the head of this branch.
